summary: This clinical trial is studying a combination medicine called Ezefeno Tablet for adults who have type 2 diabetes and dyslipidemia, which means having abnormal levels of fats in the blood. Researchers want to compare this combination treatment against increasing the dose of a standard cholesterol-lowering drug. The study is currently recruiting 3958 participants. People taking part will be followed for 48 months to track heart and blood vessel events.
